content: <memclass> shall be defined as <snp>[_<vi>_<ai>]_<sadm> if no MemorySection . memclassSymbol is applicable (see [SWS_Rte_06739]) and where <snp> is the Section Name Prefix according [SWS_Rte_07595] and [SWS_Rte_07596], <vi> is the vendorId of the BSW module, <ai> is the vendorApiInfix of the BSW module, and <sadm> is the shortName of the referred swAddrMethod .
